staging:
the operator's notes, R7_common.md): hands off the body and above the desk while she speaks; elbows out so
the upper arms clear the torso and breasts by >= 3 cm; the mic is on HER LEFT, so big gestures are her RIGHT hand, or
both hands in front of her sternum (inside her shoulder line), never past her left shoulder line; her left hand alone
only small and low. The graphic panel (CAM_MCU_L shots) is on frame right = HER LEFT: a deictic to it is her right hand
across the body, open palm, chest height, stopping ~15 cm left of her sternum (under the mic head, never into it),
with her head and eyes turning ~10 deg that way and straight back to the lens.

pre.note: Already alive when the cut opens: a soft closed-mouth smile building, a small head tilt to her right (4 deg), an inhale with the shoulders rising 1 cm, hands up off the desk in a loose high rest (fingertips touching, forearms just off the desk edge, elbows out). A small lean in from 0.4 s.

lines.text: Netflix has over three hundred million paying members.

face.note: full Duchenne: cheeks up, eyes squint

gestures.note: palm up and slightly out, chest height, presenting
hands start 15 cm apart in front of her sternum on 'three', spread to shoulder width on 'million': a huge number; L hand stays below the mic

lines.text: Hit play, and it just starts.
lines.emotion: delight, easy confidence: the magic moment

gestures.note: index finger presses an imaginary play button toward the lens, collarbone height so it enters the CU
fingers spring open outward, 'ta-da', shoulders lift

face04.emotion: delight, easy confidence: the magic moment

lines.text: But the video doesn't come from the cloud.

gestures.note: 'wait a second'
a light palm-down wave away to her right

lines.text: Netflix builds its own servers, called Open Connect Appliances.

gestures.note: palms facing, shoulder width, setting a box down in front of her on 'builds', firm on 'servers'
two descending beats, the naming

lines.text: Internet providers get them free, inside their own networks.

gestures.note: offering
hands circle a space in front of her

lines.text: Every night, Netflix predicts what your area will watch.

face.note: agent-04's THINK beat; back on the lens by 'Netflix'

gestures.note: introduces the panel: cross-body open palm, chest height, stops 15 cm left of the sternum, under the mic head; head and eyes turn 10 deg with it, back by 'Netflix'
a small circle, palm up: a crystal ball
open hand toward the lens, not a jabbing finger

lines.text: And copies it to the box near you.

gestures.note: lifts a box from her right and carries it in an arc to the centre front, set down on 'box' (in front of the sternum, never past her left shoulder line)

lines.text: Each title is encoded at many sizes and bitrates.

face.note: agent-04's THINK beat; back on the lens by 'title'

gestures.note: hands frame a small box on 'many'...
...and widen to shoulder width on 'sizes'
flat palm steps up three rungs

lines.note: CU: gestures held high (collarbone to chin) so the hands enter the bottom of the frame; the shoulders carry the rest

lines.text: A cartoon needs fewer bits than an action film, so each gets its own ladder.
The video is cut into chunks a few seconds long.

gestures.note: a few seconds: hands a short span apart

lines.text: Your player picks the right rung for every chunk.
Network dips? The next chunk is a little softer.

face.note: brows up and held through 'dips?', the bar names this one

gestures.note: flat palm-down hand dips toward the panel (cross-body, chest height, under the mic head)
it's fine
thumb and index almost touching

lines.text: Your login, profile, recommendations: that all runs on AWS.
lines.emotion: confident, brisk list, then a clean landing

gestures.note: index up (1)
+ middle (2)
+ ring (3)
palms up, spread to shoulder width: 'all of it'; L hand below and inside the mic line
